name: Practice Set 1
note: Two parts migrated from BandUp v1. A full IELTS Listening paper has four parts and 40 questions.

parts.context: A phone call about joining a community class

lines: Receptionist
Good morning, Riverside Community Centre. How can I help you?
Caller
Hi. I'd like to sign up for the evening English conversation class, please.
Receptionist
Of course. Can I take your full name?
Caller
Yes. It's Daniel Okafor. That's O, K, A, F, O, R.
Receptionist
Thank you, Daniel. And what's the best phone number for you?
Caller
It's oh, seven, seven, four, nine, two, three, one, five, eight.
Receptionist
Lovely. The class runs on Tuesdays and Thursdays. Which day would suit you?
Caller
Tuesdays are difficult because I work late, so Thursday, please.
Receptionist
Thursday it is. The class starts at a quarter past seven and finishes at nine.
Caller
Great. And how much does it cost?
Receptionist
It's normally eighty dollars for the ten-week course, but students and seniors pay fifty-five.
Caller
I'm not a student any more, so I'll pay the full price.
Receptionist
No problem. Oh, and the class is held in the library room on the second floor, not in the main hall.
Caller
The library room, second floor. Got it. Thanks so much.

questions.explain: He spells it out: O, K, A, F, O, R. Spelled names are very common in Section 1.
'Oh' means zero. Listen for the digits one by one and write them as numbers.
Tuesday is mentioned first, but it is rejected. The answer comes after 'so'.
'A quarter past seven' is 7:15. Nine is the finish time, not the start.
$55 is for students and seniors. He says he is not a student, so he pays $80.
The speaker corrects a likely guess: 'not in the main hall'. Distractors like this are common.

parts.context: A guided tour introduction at a museum

lines: Guide

Welcome, everyone, to the Harbour Maritime Museum. Before we begin, a few practical points. The museum opened in nineteen eighty-seven in what used to be the town's fish market, and it was extended in twenty fifteen, when the new glass gallery was added. Today we'll start on the ground floor with the shipwreck collection. It's our most popular exhibit, so it's best to see it now, before the school groups arrive later this morning. Photography is allowed everywhere except in the map room, because the old maps are damaged by camera flash. Please note that the café on the top floor closes at three o'clock today, rather than the usual five, as there is a private event this evening. And finally, if you'd like to try our sailing simulator, please book a time at the information desk, as places are limited.

questions.explain: 'In what used to be the town's fish market.'

questions.prompt: Visitors should see the shipwreck collection first because
options: it is on the top floor
questions.explain: School groups arrive later, so it will be crowded. That is the meaning of 'before the school groups arrive'.
'Everywhere except in the map room.' Listen for 'except'.

questions.prompt: Today the café will close at
questions.explain: 5 pm is the usual time. Today it is 'three o'clock … rather than the usual five'.
